title: people-ops-recruiting-coordinator-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-10
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick notes + to-dos
Date: 2026-03-10 (Tue)
Owner: Sam Park (recruiting coordinator)

TOP 3 for today:
- [ ] Confirm final interview panel for Backend Eng (Maya K) - needs confirmation from Hari and Lena by noon PT
- [ ] Send follow-up emails to 3 PM candidates (scheduling changes)
- [ ] Prep offer packet for SDE II (Greenhouse GH-2345) to send after approvals

Morning quick wins (do first)
- Call with hiring manager (Hari) 9:30 AM PT - agenda: interview rubric updates, can we move candidate A to on-site?
- Block 10:15-11:00 AM for candidate callback windows (reschedules)

Candidate follow-ups (quick notes)
- Candidate: Maya Thompson - interview feedback mostly positive, concern about 2/3 culture fit Qs. Follow-up by EOD: ask PM for additional context. (GH: Maya T / status: onschedule)
- Candidate: Diego Rivera - reschedule request from 3/11 to 3/12 1PM PT. Confirmed via Calendly link in thread. Update GH and Slack.
- Candidate: Priya Singh - pending final reference check (email sent yesterday). If no response by 3/11, escalate to recruiter Priya N.

Scheduling reminders
- Use zoned times in subject lines (PT/ET)
- Double-check panel availability before confirming (Hari, Lena, Jordan)
- For all reschedules, update Greenhouse and post a quick note in #recruiting (thread pinned to job)

Interview logistics to verify
- Backend Eng on-site (3/18): catering order (vegan + GF), room booked (Conf C), laptop loaner for candidate - SRE to confirm.
- Panel interview kit: scorecards printed / shared in Confluence link (confluence:people-ops/interview-scorecards)

Offer actions
- SDE II (GH-2345) - approvals outstanding from Dir Eng and Finance. Email Dir Eng (Lena) reminder at 2 PM PT if no reply.
- Prepare compensation summary + equity slide - reach out to Total Rewards for current comp bands. Attach to GH as doc.

Background checks & onboarding docs
- Start background check for new hires only after signed offer returned.
- Checklist: signed offer, ID, completed I-9, bank details, KYC if needed. Use onboarding template (link in Confluence).

Notes to self / friction points
- Hiring manager sometimes forgets to update GH disposition - remind them to enter quick note after interviews.
- Need a short template for candidate reschedule confirmations (so we stop sending long emails). Draft later today.
- Create a recurring 15-min sync with Hari on Tuesdays for role status updates.

Slack / comms
- Post a quick update in #recruiting after 11 AM with outstanding opens and any interview holes.
- DM hiring managers if panel missing one reviewer 24 hours before interview.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Is there a new vendor for background checks? (asked ops on 3/09 - waiting)
- Can we get standard offer approval turn-around SLA documented? (ask HR ops)

End-of-day checklist
- [ ] Update GH statuses for all interviews completed today
- [ ] Send candidate feedback emails (templated)
- [ ] Confirm offer approval chain status
- [ ] Post daily 3-line update to #recruiting

Random notes / snippets (scratch)
- Candidate timezone: list as TZ in GH notes (ex: PST)
- Quick template idea: "Thanks for the update - we can move to X date/time. Please reply with confirmation."
- Link to Calendly for quick panel: https://calendly.com/redwood-recruiter/panel

If time this afternoon:
- Draft reschedule template + add to GH templates folder
- Clean up interview scorecard PDFs in Confluence

Misc references
- Greenhouse job: GH-2345 (SDE II)
- Slack thread: #recruiting ts:1678451200.000200
- Jira task: HR-87 (ref checks tracking)

Last modified quick note: updated Diego reschedule, added Hari 9:30 agenda.
